tagline: A technology leader in the digital transformation of industries
hero_kpi_rationale: The Electrification segment is a strategic pillar of ABB, driven by the energy transition and the growth of sustainable electrical infrastructure, particularly in smart cities and electric mobility.

ai_positioning.summary: ABB integrates artificial intelligence into its industrial solutions through its ABB Ability™ platform, focusing on process optimization and predictive maintenance.
evidence: Launch of NeoGear, an innovation in low-voltage electrical equipment.
Use of the ABB Ability™ platform for predictive analytics and cybersecurity.
Development of intelligent automation solutions for the factories of the future.

kpis.name: Electrification Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the division specialized in electrical solutions for buildings, infrastructure and industries.
kpis.description: The Electrification segment contributed steadily to ABB's revenue, supported by demand for energy efficiency and electric charging solutions.

kpis.name: Industrial Automation Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from automated systems for process and discrete industries.
kpis.description: The segment was affected in 2019 by demand decline, particularly in robotics, due to economic uncertainty.

kpis.name: Motion Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue related to electric motors, variable speed drives and drive solutions.
kpis.description: The Motion segment remains resilient thanks to integration in critical industrial applications.

kpis.name: Robotics & Discrete Automation Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from industrial robots and automation solutions for production.
kpis.description: The segment suffered from weak automation investments, particularly in Asia and Europe.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross Margin — gross profit divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects ABB's industrial efficiency and the added value of its solutions.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin improved thanks to organizational simplification and efficiency gains.

kpis.name: R&D as % Revenue
kpis.description: ABB maintains a moderate R&D level, focused on energy efficiency and digital platforms.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Headcount — total number of employees at period end.
kpis.description: Headcount declined following internal restructuring and refocus on the four core businesses.

kpis.name: Orders
kpis.explanation: Measures orders received by ABB, indicating future demand and commercial health.

kpis.name: Book-to-Bill
kpis.explanation: Ratio of received orders to sales; indicates whether future demand is growing or declining.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Measures real cash generated after investments, showing the company's ability to fund growth and dividends.

kpis.name: Electrification Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Measures the percentage profit margin ABB's Electrification division generates from its sales.

kpis.name: Motion Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Measures ABB Motion division profitability: what percentage of sales becomes profit before taxes.

kpis.name: Dividend
kpis.explanation: Dividend measures the money ABB distributes yearly to shareholders as a reward for their investment.

kpis.name: Net Cash
kpis.explanation: Measures cash available after debt repayment, indicating financial strength and investment capacity.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability
